description: DiligenceOps: submit a claim (product, listing or diligence claim, as text or a list of parts) and the evidence text or excerpts offered for it. The signed report marks each part of the claim supported, unsupported or contradicted by the supplied evidence, quoting up to three evidence lines per part with their excerpt and offset, and naming the terms and figures no evidence carries. POST /api/claim-evidence-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no account access, no merchant contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/diligence-checks-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

claim.description: The claim as one string, which is split into parts, or the parts as a list.

evidence.description: Evidence text, or up to 200 excerpts as {source, text}. Up to 256 KB in all.
